# Alusra Clinics (عيادات الأسرة)

> Dental and dermatology clinics in Hafr Al-Batin, Saudi Arabia, operating for
> over 20 years. Two specialties: dentistry and dermatology. Bookings are made
> via WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Name: Alusra Clinics / عيادات الأسرة
- Legal owner: Wiqayat Alusra Medical Company (Saudi), CR No. 2511008308, Tax No. 300908565400003
- Location: Hafr Al-Batin, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +966 137 233 900
- Email: info@alusraclinics.com
- Languages: Arabic and English (site available at /ar and /en)
- Booking: every service, offer, and doctor links directly to WhatsApp with a
  pre-filled message naming the service. First consultation is free; medical
  insurance is accepted.
- Specialties:
  - Dentistry: orthodontics, gum treatment, cosmetic dentistry, pediatric
    dentistry, root canal treatment, dental implants
  - Dermatology: skin care, acne treatment, skin rejuvenation, other skin
    conditions

## FAQ summary
- Booking: via WhatsApp from any service/offer/doctor page; our team confirms the time.
- Insurance: accepted — confirm coverage with our team on WhatsApp.
- First consultation: free.
- Location: Hafr Al-Batin, Saudi Arabia — directions via Google Maps on the contact page.
